reason: Both share the AP-1 immediate-early, JNK/TAK1, UV/NO stress, ARE mRNA-decay and IL-6/ERK-feedback contexts, but B repeats them across 21 heavily overlapping IEG+p38/MAPK-feedback variants; its extra liver-regeneration and T-cell themes don't make up for that clutter, so A is the clearer picture.

B covers the same real facets (TOM/TIM core import, cristae/MICOS, presequence processing and degradation, UPRmt chaperones, MCU/calcium, mitophagy, OXPHOS assembly, mitochondrial gene expression) in 12 themes, while A stacks many near-duplicate mtRNA/translation supersets and drifts into cytosolic translation, RQC and polyamines.

A keeps an adrenoceptor/alpha-2 epinephrine signaling-and-secretion theme and a focused MAO/COMT catabolism theme, which are central to epinephrine and missing from B; this outweighs A's somewhat redundant transporter/degradation ladders.

B adds focused reticulophagy/selective-autophagy and ERAD-quality-control themes, which capture core UFMylation biology (UFL1/DDRGK1-driven ER-phagy and translocon quality control) and are entirely absent from A, even though B is cluttered with many overlapping UPR/translocation/glycosylation variants.

A adds real P2Y facets that B lacks (Gi-mediated adenylyl-cyclase inhibition with Gbeta-gamma/PLC-beta coupling, neuron-glial ATP signaling, and ectonucleotidase/nucleoside-transport turnover), at the cost of only modest redundancy in its eicosanoid themes.

B keeps the same HSF1 contexts (acetylation, stress granules/PKR, p53/anoikis, FOXO, UPRmt/aggrephagy, chaperonin plus UPR/ISR) in 12 themes, while A adds mostly near-duplicate chaperone/UPR variants with little new biology beyond one HSP90-cycle term.
